slug: 2026-04-13 Helios Towers completes 133 UCSAF sites to expand rural connectivity in Tanzania

facts.fact: Helios Towers completed 133 telecom sites under Tanzania's government-led Universal Communications Service Access Fund (UCSAF) programme to extend connectivity to rural and underserved communities, per Tech Review Africa.

The UCSAF programme is described as a government-led initiative extending telecommunications infrastructure to areas where connectivity has been limited or commercially unviable, per Tech Review Africa.
